subject: IAM Evidence Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC - next steps
messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@vastlyhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@vastlyhealth.com
Date: 2026-03-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence we discussed on call

Marissa - thanks again for the call today, really helpful overview of Redwood's runtime and the Dedicated offering. As we discussed, our Security and Procurement teams need to validate a few IAM controls before we can move forward with a pilot. Could you please provide the following items (or point me to where we can download them)?

1) SOC 2 status and a short summary of scope (type, date, any exceptions)
2) SSO/SAML configuration guide (metadata, cert rotation cadence, supported IdPs)
3) SCIM provisioning documentation (supported attributes, delta sync behavior, provisioning/deprovisioning timeline)
4) RBAC & admin controls (default role matrix, ability to limit admin actions, audit log retention for admin events)
5) Any formal vendor security questionnaire (we have an XLSX we can send)

Also: our timeline is tight - we need to complete the security review by the end of next week (2026-03-13) to hit our pilot start on 04/01. If you can confirm ETA on the items above, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
John
Director, IT Security
Vastly Health

Attachments: vastly-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (referenced)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@vastlyhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence we discussed on call

John - appreciate the clear list. We're happy to share everything you need. Quick status and proposed next steps below: 

STATUS
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II accredited; latest report completed 2025-11-01. I've attached a 1-page SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). For the full report we typically execute an NDA/TPA; let me know if you need a copy and I'll route it.
- SSO/SAML: Attaching our SAML configuration guide (saml-setup-guide.pdf) that includes metadata, supported IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and cert rotation notes.
- SCIM: We'll provide a SCIM provisioning diagram and attribute mapping - Aditya will create the diagram and sample payloads.
- RBAC/Admin: Monica will surface the role matrix and admin controls export. We log admin-level events to our audit service with 13 months retention by default; retention can be extended for Dedicated customers.

NEXT STEPS / ETA
1) I'll share the attachments now (SOC summary + SAML guide).
2) Aditya will send the SCIM provisioning diagram and sample scripts by EOD 2026-03-04.
3) Monica will send the RBAC matrix and admin-control screenshots by 2026-03-05.
4) If you want, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up with Aditya/Monica next week to walk through the SCIM flow and any custom attribute mapping. 

For the vendor questionnaire you mentioned, feel free to upload it to the Google Drive link above or send it back inline and we'll fill it out.

Call to action: Does 2026-03-05 for the complete package work for your security team? If yes I'll schedule the follow-up technical review on 03/06.

Thanks - Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, saml-setup-guide.pdf

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence we discussed on call

Looping in quick technical notes so we have a single source of truth for responses to Vastly: 

- SCIM: I'll produce a provisioning diagram (scim-provisioning-diagram.png) and a sample PATCH/PUT payload set. Key implementation details: support for /Users and /Groups, bulk delta support (changetype + timestamp), and provisioning latency typically under 30s for single-user events. We support custom attribute mapping via a small mapping table in the console or via API.
- SAML cert rotation: certs are rotated every 12 months by default; customers can upload new certs in the console and we support rolling certs for zero-downtime rotation. I'll document the exact header names for metadata exchange.
- RBAC/admin: our role model has Owner, Admin, Developer, ReadOnly; Owners can manage billing and admins, Admins can manage configs and users, Developers can deploy models/routes, ReadOnly is for observers. We'll export a CSV of role permissions.

I'll aim to have the SCIM diagram and sample payloads in your shared Drive link by EOD 2026-03-04. If you want to see live provisioning, I can demo with a test tenant in our sandbox during the 03/06 sync.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@vastlyhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@vastlyhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence we discussed on call

John / Procurement team - attaching the materials we discussed and confirming next steps. See inline summary below and links to docs.

Summary of attachments/links
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf - SOC 2 Type II summary (full report available under NDA)
- saml-setup-guide.pdf - SAML metadata, supported IdPs, cert rotation notes
- scim-provisioning-diagram.png - SCIM flow + supported attributes (sample payloads in Drive)
- role-permissions.csv - exported RBAC matrix (attached in Drive link)

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-sso-config (contains the SCIM payloads, CSV, and a short demo recording)

Open questions / notes
- Audit logs: default retention is 13 months; for Dedicated customers we can configure longer retention and export to your SIEM via our secure connector.
- Full SOC 2 report: we can share under a standard TPA; let me know the contact and I'll initiate.
- Questionnaire: we filled out the rows in your vendor questionnaire and uploaded it to the Drive folder (file: vastly-vendor-questionnaire-filled.xlsx).

I've scheduled a 30-min technical review for 2026-03-06 10:00 AM PT with Aditya and Monica to walk through SCIM and SAML. If you'd prefer a different time, let me know.

Thanks - looking forward to keeping this moving.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, saml-setup-guide.pdf, scim-provisioning-diagram.png
